citationText: 4. Film was actually very hard! One of the first tasks the SMPE (the Society of Motion Picture Engineers, a precursor to the current SMPTE) took on was the standardization of film. Without this effort, film technology would have wallowed for many years. For an excellent description of these early standardization efforts, see Technological History of Motion Pictures and Television: An Anthology from the Pages of the “Journal of the Society of Motion Picture and Television Engineers” by Raymond Fielding (hardcover, Jan. 31, 1980)
